gen-righteous-gf-martel-sans: Righteous bends every letter like thin steel rod, with bowls that fill the line and a confident, playful swagger. Martel Sans is the quieter partner, its curves generously open and its lowercase standing high, so the loud heading never gets crowded.
gen-righteous-gf-matangi: Righteous fills each bowl right to the edge of the line, a commanding, playful shape bent from thin steel rod. Matangi counters with a hefty, rounded sans that stays open and easy over paragraphs.
gen-righteous-gf-maven-pro: Modern in a low-key way, Maven Pro keeps its lines gentle and its lowercase high-waisted, with an inviting gap in the c. And Righteous above it brings the swagger, bowls packed full like bent rod.
gen-righteous-gf-michroma: Michroma gives every letter a wide berth, its tall lowercase and stubby ascender tips set off by open curves. Righteous above it is the livelier voice, bowls packed full, so a long page of text feels spacious.
gen-righteous-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads big and friendly, its oversized lowercase hung out like clothespins on a line. But Righteous carries the swagger above, so let the body size stay generous.
gen-righteous-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One spaces its letters wide, with a sizable lowercase and no brush swell. Righteous sits over it with fuller bowls and a commanding, playful punch, and the two split the page into loud and easygoing.
gen-righteous-gf-montserrat-underline: Righteous looks like thin steel rod bent into letters, every bowl filling its line with brash fun. Montserrat Underline answers with hollow-reed counters and a big lowercase, so the heading's swagger gets room to breathe.
gen-righteous-gf-mozilla-headline: Approachable is the first word for Mozilla Headline, with its big-bodied lowercase and splayed c terminal. And Righteous overhead supplies the punch, its bowls filled out and its strokes uniform like bent rod.
gen-righteous-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text looks bold for a body face because its lowercase stands so tall, with terminals flaring outward. But Righteous is the heavier showman, thick outlines throughout, so the two sit comfortably apart.
gen-righteous-gf-nata-sans: Clean and modern, Nata Sans holds a large central band with wide, unclosed curves and a technical-pen steadiness. And Righteous does the opposite job best, commanding attention with bowls that fill the line.
